criteria.name: Client interview and fact gathering
criteria.description: Conducts a thorough, well-structured interview of the personal representative and develops the full factual record, including the facts adverse to the estate.

subcriteria.name: Rapport and eliciting difficult facts
subcriteria.description: Builds genuine rapport and reassurance sufficient to surface the rapport-gated and concealed facts (the client's role in arranging the will, the phone fight, the account withdrawals) without pressure or leading.

subcriteria.name: Chronology and completeness
subcriteria.description: Assembles an accurate chronology and covers capacity, caregiving, finances, and family history without material gaps.

criteria.name: Capacity and undue-influence analysis
criteria.description: Separates testamentary capacity from undue influence and maps the record evidence to the elements of each.

subcriteria.name: Testamentary capacity
subcriteria.description: Correctly frames capacity as measured at execution and weighs the physician's assessment, attorney and witness observations, and the cognitive diagnosis.

subcriteria.name: Undue influence and presumption
subcriteria.description: Identifies the confidential-relationship / suspicious-circumstances / active-participation factors, the possible burden-shifting presumption, and the estate's independence-of-execution counter-facts.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility
criteria.description: Spots and addresses the ethics issues raised by the firm's role and the adverse party's representation.

subcriteria.name: Lawyer-as-witness
subcriteria.description: Recognizes that the drafting attorney is a likely necessary witness and analyzes how the firm may proceed.

subcriteria.name: No-contact with represented party
subcriteria.description: Recognizes that the contestant is represented and that direct contact is prohibited; routes contact through counsel.

criteria.name: Counseling the distressed client
criteria.description: Counsels the grieving personal representative with candor and care, managing her fear of being cast as a manipulator while still addressing the adverse facts and her fiduciary duties.

criteria.name: Interview memo and litigation posture
criteria.description: Produces a clear, well-organized interview memo that states the estate's problem, the analysis, the ethics issues, and next steps in defending the contest.
